# {{ site.data.settings.title }}

> Personal website and blog of Tomasz Dziurko, {{ site.data.settings.seo.job_title }} at {{ site.data.settings.seo.works_for.name }} ({{ site.data.settings.seo.works_for.url }}), a 100% remote software consultancy and part of the VirtusLab group. He writes about scaling engineering organizations, remote-first culture, engineering progression systems (career ladders), post-acquisition integration and, in older posts, Java/JVM programming, conferences and book reviews. Posts are in English, some in Polish.

Key facts about the author:

- Leads engineering progression and growth for ~80 engineers at SoftwareMill; co-authored its badge-based engineering ladder.
- Elected VP of Engineering in a company-wide vote in a flat organization (92.7% in favour at 88% turnout).
- 15 years as a software engineer and team leader (Java, Scala); MBA, Kozminski University (2024).
- Community: co-organized the Confitura conference, led the Warsaw Java User Group, founded JVM Poland and JVM Bloggers.
